prompt:
This is a retail receipt (storefront, restaurant, or supermarket). Extract the fields below.

IMPORTANT — extract every value EXACTLY as printed on the page (verbatim). Do NOT normalize, reformat, translate, round, or compute anything:
- Keep dates and times in their original on-page form (do not convert to ISO 8601, do not change the locale's separator).
- Keep prices with their original currency symbols, digits, and separators as shown (e.g. ¥1,200 — never strip the symbol, never sum line items into a subtotal that isn't printed).
- Keep phone numbers, addresses, and store identifiers exactly as printed; do not standardize hyphens/spacing.
- Only return a value that is literally printed on the receipt; never derive subtotal/tax/total from the line items if it is not actually shown.
- Return an empty string for anything not present.

Verbatim values let the engine anchor each value to its exact spot on the page; reformatted values cannot be located precisely.

columns.name: store_name
columns.description: Store / merchant name as printed at the top of the receipt

columns.name: store_address
columns.description: Store address line, verbatim; empty if absent

columns.name: store_phone
columns.description: Store phone number, verbatim with the original formatting; empty if absent

columns.name: transaction_date
columns.description: Transaction date exactly as printed; empty if absent

columns.name: transaction_time
columns.description: Transaction time exactly as printed; empty if absent

columns.name: receipt_no
columns.description: Receipt / transaction number exactly as printed; empty if absent

columns.name: items
columns.description: Line items, one element per printed row

children.name: quantity
children.description: Quantity as printed; empty if no explicit quantity column

children.name: unit_price
children.description: Unit price as printed; empty if not shown per row

children.name: amount
children.description: Line amount as printed (price × quantity); the value the receipt actually shows for this row

columns.name: subtotal
columns.description: Subtotal exactly as printed; empty if not shown as a single line

columns.name: tax
columns.description: Tax amount exactly as printed (e.g. 消費税 / VAT / Sales Tax); empty if not shown as a single value

columns.name: total
columns.description: Grand total exactly as printed (合計 / Total / 総額)

columns.name: payment_method
columns.description: Payment method as printed (cash / credit card / brand name); empty if absent
